integrity: A self-contained invariant-theory proof and exact independent symbolic checks are supplied. Literature comparison is limited by the possibility of earlier results under classical invariant terminology; no claim of independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Only reduced divisorial branch support and generic inertia for the coordinate S6 action are determined; codimension-two inertia, quotient singularities, and full automorphism group are not classified. The known K3 smoothness and geometry of the initiating model are used.
title: Two ramification divisors and the full permutation fixed-locus profile of the Hamilton K3 surface
